prompt: Use case: game asset. Original premium hand-painted anime monster SPRITE ATLAS. A small round dark purple crystal imp with tiny legs and an orange crescent crystal on its back. This is an unstable moon-energy explosive creature, playful but threatening, not a real bomb. Exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows (12 full separate figures). Row1 idle subtle breathing four phases. Row2 locomotion four clear alternating phases (wingbeats for bat, float for hand/wisp, feet for others). Row3 attack anticipation, release, followthrough, recovery. Front three-quarter angle consistent identity and size. Each sprite is a complete isolated silhouette with generous transparent margin, NEVER touches adjacent frame. Truly transparent background. No particles detached from silhouette, no grid, no words, no labels, no scenery. Crisp polished mobile game sprites with soft painterly shading, no pixel art, no humans, no extra monsters.
